about: Unmigrated files that still break a UX source rule. Every entry needs an owner (the slice that removes it) and a reason. test_ux_source_hygiene.py fails when a listed file no longer violates its rule, so the list only shrinks. rule is one of banned-import, no-chinese, global-hook, key-fallback; path is relative to desktop/src/main/kotlin/com/bilipai/desktop. The no-chinese rule covers every file of PROGRAM_GLOBS in ux_source.py (not only the strict text files); the banned-import rule covers material3 and Material 2 (androidx.compose.material). Slice V0 (the carrier wheel input, spec 6.4) must register its wheel input through window.addMouseWheelListener, because the global-hook rule bans Toolkit.addAWTEventListener; if a global listener is truly unavoidable, V0 adds an entry {rule: global-hook, path: appearance/DesktopWindowsCarrierScaleInput.kt, owner: V0, reason: ...}.
